parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Describes how the Unix Domain Socket must be used.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: File path of the Unix Domain Socket. Example: /tmp/broker_controller_path

parameters.name: AuthRequired
parameters.description: When {{true}}, USP Endpoints connecting to this Unix Domain Socket MUST authenticate themselves.

parameters.name: RegistrationRestricted
parameters.description: When {{true}}, USP Agents connecting to this Unix Domain Socket are only allowed to register data model paths permitted by the {{object|##.USPServices.Trust}} table. When {{false}}, USP Agents connecting to this Unix Domain Socket may register any data model paths (subject to the rules affecting USP Services).

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to a UnixDomainSocket configuration.
